description: Stand in Marbella's Orange Square after dark, under the lantern light. The plaza's orange trees and whitewashed houses with their wooden balconies wrap around the frame, lamps pooling warm on the cobbles. It feels less like a square than a shared courtyard — the whole old town seems to gather here at night.
